arguments.value: Troubleshooting reverse proxy and VPN routing on a QNAP NAS with OpenVPN and Caddy on Raspberry Pi 5s running Bookworm. The user has remote Pis acting as web servers on a 4G network, connected as OpenVPN clients to a NAS on the home LAN, and is trying to expose them publicly via different ports through the NAS reverse proxy and router port forwarding, but public access to mydns:81 is not working.
